title: Albert-Weasker/niubi_guard
claim: Albert-Weasker/niubi_guard — Open-source GitHub repository abuse detection and response system.
why_good: Detects and responds to GitHub repo abuse (star-farming, spam) — a real, growing problem as fake-star repos flood GitHub.
value: Sell to GitHub orgs, investors and registries who need to trust repo signals; API + reports.
risk: Narrow; GitHub itself polices abuse, and 'detection' is an arms race with limited direct buyers.
pick_reason: The project is an open-source tool that lacks a clear monetizable product or service.

zh.claim: Albert-Weasker/niubi_guard —— 开源的 GitHub 仓库滥用检测与响应系统。
zh.why_good: 检测并响应 GitHub 仓库滥用(刷星、垃圾)——随着刷星仓库泛滥,这是个真实且在扩大的问题。
zh.value: 卖给需要信任仓库信号的 GitHub 组织、投资人和注册表:API + 报告。
zh.risk: 较窄;GitHub 自己也在治理滥用,而检测是场军备竞赛,直接买家有限。
